explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/717: Erdős–Fajtlowicz showed χ(G) ≫ (n^{1/2}/log n)·σ(G) for almost all graphs. The statement gives ∃ C > 0 such that the proportion of labelled graphs on Fin n with ¬(C·(√n/log n)·σ < χ) tends to 0, out of 2^{C(n,2)} graphs. Strict versus non-strict inequality is immaterial once C is free. Faithful.
